data.description:
## Context
Planning currently mixes snapshot reads, binding decisions, mode limits, and later handler assumptions. Retry recovery cannot be stable until all decisions derive from one frozen observation.

## Outcome
Define immutable `Observation` and `TicketPlan` values and a pure planner that preserves the existing `Mutation` vocabulary/serialization. This task covers deterministic value construction only, not lifecycle dependency logic or preview output.

## Plan
1. Add frozen provider-neutral observation/version and per-ticket plan types with open payloads.
2. Build pure planner inputs from local snapshot, remote snapshot, binding read view, mode, selection/filter, and limits.
3. Refactor existing differ decisions into plan mutation values without filesystem, provider, subprocess, or clock I/O.
4. Preserve existing mutation serialization and canonical hashes exactly.

## Testing
Feed frozen fixtures twice and compare immutable plans, hashes, diagnostics, and version identity. Poison all I/O seams.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identical frozen inputs produce equal immutable observations and ticket plans.
- [ ] Plans carry existing mutations, diagnostics, disposition, and observation/version identity.
- [ ] Existing mutation serialization and canonical hashes remain byte-identical.
- [ ] Planner construction performs zero repository saves, ticket writes, Jira calls, subprocess launches, or ambient clock reads.
- [ ] Provider-specific payload extensions remain open without weakening the provider-neutral core fields.

## Out of scope
Lifecycle intents, inter-ticket dependencies, caps ordering, preview rendering, and shadow cutover.
data.title: RP-03 S2 T1 — Build immutable observations and pure ticket plans
